instruction: Apply bold formatting to all cells in the marks row (C5:F5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold to marks row C5:F5. Checking D5 as a sample cell to verify bold was applied (checking one representative cell from the range).

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires bold formatting for ALL cells in range C5:F5 (4 cells), but evaluator only checks cell D5 (1 of 4 cells)
The evaluator cannot detect if cells C5, E5, or F5 are not bolded - an agent could bold only D5 and still pass verification
Sampling approach is insufficient for explicit 'all cells' requirement - the instruction does not allow for partial completion
Getter and metric logic are individually correct, but the verification strategy is fundamentally incomplete for this task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Check all 4 cells in the range C5:F5 individually, not just one sample cell
Use multiple getter calls for cells C5, D5, E5, F5 and aggregate results (all must be bold for pass)
Or modify the getter to accept a cell range and return font properties for all cells in the range
Or modify the metric to check multiple cells and return partial scores (e.g., 0.25 per cell bolded, 1.0 if all 4 are bolded)
